policy: Read-only raw-source audit; no current output cloud, registration transform, terrain levelling or PCA-up frame is read or changed.

gps_sides.method: Geographic east/west from median original H5 RTK longitude; no assumed A/B meaning

angle_definitions.wall_from_vertical: Outward near-side centre-sheet tilt from IMU vertical; positive leans toward the viewing track
angle_definitions.ground_from_horizontal: Detected ground-plane normal angle from IMU up; ground is not flattened
angle_definitions.wall_ground_dihedral: Acute dihedral between independently fitted ground and vegetation-sheet planes
angle_definitions.central_tree_plane_ground: Angle between the balanced height-matched central observed-tree plane and equally track-weighted raw ground normals

summary.opening_caution: Sum of independently measured median near-side profile inclinations; not a matched individual-tree opening or a surveyed biological branch angle.

excluded_inputs.reason: Byte-identical duplicate of sideB recording 084742; GPS places it on the B track
Incomplete capture: one lidar packet, zero duration and no IMU packets

limits: The IMU median is used without inferred bias correction; factory calibration uncertainty remains.
Occlusion, supports, crown curvature and feature selection affect a vegetation-sheet inclination.
Different scans view overlapping trees; scan-to-scan ranges are not independent survey confidence intervals.
Low-cylinder roles are inferred from fitted size, not verified tree/post identities.
Presence of a feature in these raw scans rules out its creation by later registration, but does not alone establish biological shape.

central_tree_plane.definition: Plane through the height-matched midpoint of equally weighted east/west mean observed-tree profiles; all selected tree returns, not individual V-arm angles
central_tree_plane.limits: Statistical observed-tree centre, not a surveyed trunk/symmetry plane. Occlusion and foliage/support visibility can bias centres. Origins are independent raw low-row/ground references; absolute cross-side positions are not registered.

primary_method: Central observed-tree plane from equally weighted east/west profiles at matched heights, using all selected tree returns; no individual arm, symmetry or upright target.
